leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a TypeScript interface to define a retry policy configuration
Construct a function that validates retry policy parameters against type constraints
Apply type annotations to enforce limits on retry attempts and delay intervals
Configure a retry policy object with typed properties for maximum attempts and backoff strategy
Manipulate policy settings using TypeScript's type system to ensure runtime safety
Initialize a default retry configuration with proper type definitions
Integrate the typed retry policy into a simulated API call function
